title: Eidah Hachareidis Bans Concerts
body: The Eidah Hachareidis' Badatz issued a strong warning against "Ervei Shira" or concerts, citing a breach in communal standards of kedushah and tznius. The proclamation expresses concern over the rapid expansion of these events.

title: Breslover Mashpia's Final Request
body: Rav Binyomin Ze'ev Knopelmacher zt”l, a 75-year-old Breslover mashpia, passed away. In accordance with his final request, struggling youth, considered "dropouts" or "at risk," carried his aron at his levayah.

title: Teen Injured in Protest
body: A 16-year-old boy injured in a protest car-ramming arrives by ambulance to file a complaint. Police say he was "summoned for questioning" despite his injuries.
